2.0.0

# 2.0.0

## New Features

Rebuilt Starting Equipment System

- The starting equipment interface has been completely rebuilt with a cleaner, more reliable design consistent with how DnD5e handles equipment choices.
- Equipment is now clearly separated into "Class Equipment" and "Background Equipment" sections.
- Equipment categories that require multiple picks now show separate dropdown menus for each selection.
- Added a "Use Starting Wealth Instead" option that lets you roll for gold or receive a flat amount depending on your rules content.
- Rolling for starting wealth can optionally post the result to chat for other players to see.
- Equipment items now show clickable item links next to their dropdowns, letting you hover or click to view item details.
- Linked equipment items now have checkboxes so you can uncheck items you do not want.
- Equipment dropdowns now only show items your character is actually proficient with based on your race, class, and background.

Redesigned Review Tab

- The Review tab now uses a clean two-column grid layout with Basic Info, Ability Scores, Proficiencies, Equipment, and Biography sections.
- Proficiencies display in a compact comma-separated list grouped by category, with icons and hover tooltips showing which source grants each proficiency.
- The Review tab now updates automatically whenever you change any form field.

Redesigned Biography Tab

- The Biography tab is now organized into three clearly labeled sections: Characteristics, Identity, and Backstory.
- Personality traits, ideals, bonds, flaws, and physical description are grouped together under Identity.

Light Mode Support

- Added light mode support so the interface text is easier to read when using Foundry's light theme.

Compact Button Setting

- Added a "Compact Button" setting that lets you choose between a small egg icon or a full-size button with text in the Actors tab.
- Hovering over the button now shows a proper Foundry-style tooltip.

Inline Compendium Settings

- The Custom Compendiums settings window now shows all four compendium categories side by side with checkboxes, instead of requiring a separate pop-up for each category.
- "Select All" checkboxes are available per source group for faster configuration.
- If you save without selecting any compendiums in a category, all available compendiums are automatically selected as a fallback.

Inline Advancement Order Setting

- The advancement order configuration has been moved directly into the Customization settings window instead of living in its own separate pop-up.
- The tab navigation order in the character creator now dynamically follows your configured advancement order.

---

## Enhancements

Foundry Standard Form Layout

- All tabs and settings windows now use Foundry's standard form layout, making the entire interface visually consistent with the rest of Foundry.
- Dropdown labels now use descriptive text like "Choose a Race" instead of just the category name.
- Removed bordered fieldset boxes and introductory text from selection tabs for a cleaner appearance.

Improved Ability Score Tab

- Each ability score method now displays inside its own labeled section instead of sharing one large box.
- Point Buy now shows remaining and total points directly in the section heading.
- Plus and minus buttons for Point Buy now use clean icon-based controls, and the dice roll button is now a proper button element.

Redesigned Settings Windows

- The Customization settings window is now organized into clearly labeled sections: General Options, Character Appearance Options, and Character Options.
- The Dice Rolling settings window is now organized by generation method with clearly labeled sections.
- Settings for a disabled method are visually dimmed and non-interactive.
- The Mandatory Fields settings now use a single "Ability Scores" checkbox instead of individual checkboxes for each ability, organized into five cleaner groups.

Improved Start Tab Layout

- The Start tab now organizes fields under "Player Settings" and "Token Settings" groups.
- The welcome message has been shortened to a concise summary.

Streamlined Notifications

- Removed noisy or redundant popup notifications during normal use such as loading and per-item progress toasts.
- Multiple related notifications are now combined into a single message.
- Error messages that require action now stay on screen until dismissed.
- Stale notification toasts are automatically cleared when starting a new action.

Full Localization of Validation Messages

- All validation and error messages during character creation are now fully translatable.
- The word "or" used when listing multiple race sizes is now translatable.

Equipment Display Improvements

- Equipment section headers now display the actual name of your chosen class or background.
- The starting wealth formula is shown next to the gold input field as a denomination label.
- Empty equipment choice groups are automatically hidden.
- "Pick one" equipment choices now use a cleaner dropdown menu instead of radio buttons.
- Background equipment choices display as radio buttons matching the class equipment style instead of being unnecessarily nested.

---

## Bug Fixes

Fix Module Compatibility Setting Conflict

- Fixed a bug where enabling one module compatibility setting would overwrite another, so both compatible modules can now work at the same time.

Fix Duplicate Actions on Form Changes

- Fixed duplicate actions firing when changing form fields or viewing descriptions, such as validation checks and race size updates running twice.

Fix Equipment Item Count Display

- Fixed equipment item counts so items with a quantity of one no longer display a redundant "1" prefix.

Fix Drag-and-Drop Advancement Reordering

- Fixed the drag-and-drop feature for reordering advancement processing so it works correctly on Foundry V13.

Fix Missing SRD Focus Items

- Fixed an issue where certain SRD 5.1 focus items like holy symbols or arcane focuses were not appearing in equipment choices.

Fix Race Selection Outside Folders

- Fixed an issue where races listed outside of folders in the selection dropdown were missing identifying information, which could cause the wrong race to load.

Fix Cancel Button Behavior

- Fixed the cancel button so it behaves correctly as a standard button instead of an invalid type that could cause unexpected form behavior.

Fix Error Message on Settings Reset

- Fixed the error message when resetting options to correctly say "Failed to reset" instead of "Failed to save."

Fix Druid Shield Equipment Selection

- Fixed a bug where Druids and potentially other classes saw "no items available" when selecting shields in their starting equipment.
- Fixed equipment filtering so unrelated items like trinkets, clothing, and vehicles no longer appear in armor and shield selections.

Fix Equipment Dropdown Sort Order

- Fixed equipment dropdowns so their options are now sorted alphabetically.

Remove Unarmed Strike from Weapon Dropdowns

- Removed "Unarmed Strike" from weapon selection dropdowns since it is not an equippable weapon.

Fix Multi-Quantity Items Creating Separate Entries

- Fixed a bug where items with a quantity were added as multiple separate entries on the character sheet instead of a single item with the correct quantity.

Fix Starting Wealth and Coin Pouch Processing

- Fixed a bug where rolling for starting wealth would trigger the dice roll a second time when finalizing the character.
- Fixed the "Use Starting Wealth" checkbox state not being properly saved when submitting the form.
- Fixed coin pouch items not loading their gold values correctly, resulting in missing currency on the created character.

Fix Mandatory Field Validation and Progress Bar

- Fixed the submit button not working when ability scores were set as mandatory.
- Fixed the progress bar not updating after adjusting Point Buy scores or randomizing ability scores.
- Fixed Point Buy validation reading stale values instead of actual current scores.
- Fixed mandatory field indicator icons bleeding into label text and being too large.
- Certain non-applicable fields are no longer counted toward the progress bar.

Fix Rollable Table Results from Locked Compendiums

- Fixed a bug where rolling on a rollable table stored in a locked compendium pack would fail silently.
- Fixed rollable table draws not returning the correct result text.

Fix Review Tab Display Issues

- Fixed "unknown" placeholder text displaying as a formatting tag instead of plain text.
- Fixed the Review tab showing a generic "unknown" label instead of specifying which selection is missing.

Fix Settings Window Sizing and Layout

- Fixed settings windows being forced to an unnecessarily tall minimum height.
- Fixed footer buttons in the character creator potentially overlapping content.
- Fixed the character creator window opening at an inconsistent height and position.
- Reduced the default window width so the character creator takes up less screen space.
- Fixed navigation tabs not spacing correctly.
- Fixed ability score controls not wrapping properly on smaller window sizes.
- Fixed the approval screen grid layout not displaying columns correctly.

Fix Character Reset

- Resetting the character creator now properly clears race, class, and background selections instead of potentially leaving stale data behind.

---

## Other Changes

- Major internal code cleanup and modernization, removing thousands of lines of redundant code and replacing inline HTML generation with Handlebars templates.
- Updated minimum supported Foundry version to V13 and tightened DnD5e system compatibility to version 5.2.4 through 5.2.9.
- Existing customization settings are automatically migrated to the new format on first load.
- Improved screen reader accessibility for hint and description text in settings windows.
- The Hero Mancer button now appears at the end of the Actors tab header and uses a consistent neutral color.
- Removed the "favorite" star checkbox from equipment selections and the review summary.
- Removed the character portrait preview and narrative character summary from the Review tab in favor of structured review sections.
- The chat summary message sent after character creation now shows only the character name, ability scores, and inventory.
- Removed a duplicate French language entry from the module manifest.
- Tab content areas no longer shift layout when a scrollbar appears or disappears.
